# Price your app or SaaS for every country, not just the US

> Turn one price into a purchasing-power (PPP) price table for about 50 countries: damped discounts, a floor, .99 rounding, price tiers, regional discount groups and a revenue what-if for your own traffic mix. Free, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
